card.name: The word optimal in dosing statements
card.fires_on: The word "optimal" (or its ending "imal" in "opt-imal"), mostly right after sentence-initial "The" in dosage sections. It often begins a statement that the best dose or interval is not established.

modes.label: Sentence-opening "The optimal"
modes.description: "optimal" follows "The" at the start of a sentence about dose, interval or monitoring.
modes.example: DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION The<< optimal>> daily dose of calcitriol capsules

modes.label: Split-up "optimal"
modes.description: The word is broken into pieces and the pole fires on the "imal" ending.
modes.example: opt<<imal>> response to RELISTOR after three days

card.writes: It pushes toward word choices that follow "optimal" and suppresses synonyms like "appropriate" and its Chinese equivalents.
card.plain: It fires on the word "optimal" when a label talks about the best dose or timing.
